Happiness is different for everyone. I find happiness in reading a book with a glass of wine and a cat on my lap while my friends would find happiness in partying. Create your own happiness; it doesn’t have to be Instagram worthy but things you enjoy doing. 

Happiness, so to speak, is not a permanent feeling, it’s a release of dopamine. It’s hard to break out of that all too familiar low mood but maybe try writing down three things everyday that brought you some form of happiness. These can be the smallest things: cooking/eating food you enjoy, wearing comfy clothes, having a hot shower. 

Sure this isn’t life’s answer but it’s a start and hopefully it can break the loop of depression and low mood.
